messages.subject: infering arrival time for poisson process from emissions array - how to make it work?
parts:
Hello, I have simple model that should infer arrival time for poisson process from emissions array. 
But the model gives very unreasonable output. 
Inference in matlab would be like "find(emissions)" operation. So that would be arrival time. But I cannot force model to do that.
And I need to do it with model, because i want to complicate emissions, so just "find" would not work).

Can you advise how to make model infer arrival time in this simple case?
And another question: how can I see total log likelihood for each iteration in "fit" object? I suggest if I calculate likelihood from simulated in R data, it would be better. 

R code for generation data:
library(rstan) # observe startup messages
install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("cran/pracma")
library(pracma)

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

lambda = 0.3;
creationsN = 10;
rowsN = 100;
#int_times = 1/(lambda)*rexp(creationsN, rate = lambda);
int_times = 1/lambda*-log(runif(creationsN));
arr_times = cumsum(int_times);
offsetV = runif(creationsN,min=0, max=4);
arr_times2 = arr_times+offsetV;

emissions = accumarray(ceiling(arr_times),rep(1, creationsN),sz = rowsN);
barplot(emissions)

model_dat <- list(rowsN = rowsN, creationsN=creationsN, creationsLambda = lambda, obsEmissions = emissions)
fit <- stan(file = '.R/StockModels/PoissonEmission0.stan',data = model_dat,  iter = 100, chains = 1)

la<-extract(fit, permute = TRUE)
ee <-la$emissions;
eeLambda <-la$creationsLambda;

barplot(ee[1,])
barplot(emissions, beside = TRUE)


Stan model:
data {
  int<lower=0> rowsN; 
  int<lower=0> creationsN; 
  real<lower=0,upper=5> creationsLambda;
  vector[rowsN] obsEmissions;
}

parameters {
  vector<lower=0,upper=1>[creationsN] interarrivalTime_U;
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[creationsN] interarrivalTime;
  vector[creationsN] arrivalTime;

  vector[rowsN] emissions;

  interarrivalTime <- 1/creationsLambda*-log(interarrivalTime_U);
  arrivalTime <- cumulative_sum(interarrivalTime);
  arrivalTime <-sort_asc(arrivalTime);
  {
    int curInd; 
    curInd<-1;
    for(i in 1: rowsN)
    {
      emissions[i]<-0;
    }
    
    for(i in 1: rowsN)
    {
      
      while(curInd<=creationsN && arrivalTime[curInd]<i)
      {
        emissions[i] <- emissions[i] +1;
        curInd <-curInd+1;
      }
    }
  }
}

model {
  interarrivalTime_U ~ uniform(0, 1);
  (cumulative_sum(emissions)-cumulative_sum(obsEmissions)) ~ normal(0, 1);
  emissions-obsEmissions ~normal(0,1);
}
